facts.population: Digitally fabricated removable complete dentures (4 clinical studies)
facts.main_result: 3D-printed and milled complete dentures did not differ significantly in retention (SMD 0.165, P = .343) or satisfaction (SMD -0.595, P = .236).
facts.funding_coi: No external funding; no competing interests declared

facts.population: 15 edentulous patients (aged 58-83) needing upper and lower complete dentures
facts.intervention: Digitally fabricated (milled) complete denture, Ivoclar Digital Denture protocol
facts.main_result: Both denture types improved OHIP-G49 versus baseline (median 70 to 19 conventional, 16 digital) with no significant difference between them (p=0.656).
facts.funding_coi: Funded by Ivoclar; sponsor had no role in design, analysis or reporting
facts.limitations: Exploratory pilot with limited statistical power and small sample.
